multiplicity.method: Benjamini-Hochberg over one row per (model, domain, scaffold): the expanded row where a complete one exists, else the core row. Superseded core rows are excluded so shared data is not counted twice.

sensitivity.note: Family is one row per model, domain and scaffold. BH over every cell counts overlapping core and expanded rows twice; BY is the arbitrary-dependence version of the same family.

per_cell.note: Strict view. A per-cell rank at 12 matched sets is itself noisy.

direction.note: The three models see the same profiles and names, so the two profile halves are the independent unit rather than all six splits.

power.note: Power depends on (n_sets, n_groups, n_reps, d) only; the score scale cancels. Reported per replicate depth because the domains differ.
